com.docker.sandbox/acp@1.restrictions: Docker Sandboxes support has not been verified.

com.docker.sandbox/agent-context@1.restrictions: Agent instructions are applied when creating the sandbox.

com.docker.sandbox/agent-context@2.restrictions: Cloud sandboxes write one workload profile in `/home/agent`. Mixins use the workload's profile and cannot specify a `directory`. Unsupported required profiles prevent creation; optional ones are skipped.

com.docker.sandbox/agent-interactive-ses.restrictions: Docker Sandboxes does not use these session commands.

com.docker.sandbox/agent-sessions@1.restrictions: Accepted since v0.45.0, but Docker Sandboxes does not execute the declared session commands.

com.docker.sandbox/agent-skill@1.restrictions: Requires a selected `agent-skills@1` destination. Bundled skills remain available with `--skills=off`.

com.docker.sandbox/agent-skills@1.restrictions: Local sandboxes mount the shared skills store. From v0.48.0, discovery paths also receive bundled skills.

com.docker.sandbox/auto-restart@1.restrictions: Docker Sandboxes support has not been verified.

com.docker.sandbox/credential@1.restrictions: In cloud sandboxes, credentials scoped to installation remain available after setup.

com.docker.sandbox/docker-auth@1.restrictions: Docker Sandboxes support has not been verified.

com.docker.sandbox/dockerd@1.restrictions: Docker Sandboxes support has not been verified.

com.docker.sandbox/git-identity@1.restrictions: Requires `user.name` and `user.email` in the host Git config.

com.docker.sandbox/host-mount@1.restrictions: Users can [select host directories](../use-kits.md#choose-directories-for-kit-host-mounts) at creation time. Cloud sandboxes reject required entries and skip optional ones.

com.docker.sandbox/host-port@1.restrictions: Docker Sandboxes support has not been verified.

com.docker.sandbox/kit-registry@1.restrictions: Restricted to approved OCI builder kits. Local and Git kit sources do not receive registry access.

com.docker.sandbox/lifecycle@1.restrictions: Local startup hooks run alongside the agent, rather than blocking its launch.

com.docker.sandbox/long-running@1.restrictions: Keeps a local sandbox running after its last session disconnects.

com.docker.sandbox/network-policy@1.restrictions: Cloud sandboxes keep installation-phase network access after setup.

com.docker.sandbox/network-policy@2.restrictions: Cloud sandboxes enforce host rules, but not HTTP method or path restrictions. Installation-phase access remains after setup.

com.docker.sandbox/open-url@1.restrictions: Docker Sandboxes support has not been verified.

com.docker.sandbox/port@1.restrictions: Cloud sandboxes expose IPv4 TCP ports only. See [Port address families](#port-address-families).

com.docker.sandbox/privileged@1.restrictions: Accepted by the local runtime, which runs Docker-in-Docker containers in privileged mode inside the sandbox VM.

com.docker.sandbox/resources@1.restrictions: Workload CPU and memory defaults are applied. The `gpu` field does not select GPUs; cloud creation rejects a required GPU request.

com.docker.sandbox/sbx@1.restrictions: Docker Sandboxes launches the agent using the workload command.

com.docker.sandbox/ssh-agent@1.restrictions: Requires SSH-agent forwarding to be enabled and a host SSH agent to be available.

com.docker.sandbox/usb-device@1.restrictions: Kit requests for USB device access are not supported.

com.docker.sandbox/volume@1.restrictions: Local sandboxes provide block storage or tmpfs and [retain block volumes across removal and recreation](../use-kits.md#keep-kit-data-when-recreating-a-sandbox). Cloud sandboxes use ordinary sandbox disk at the declared paths, including for tmpfs requests.
